bosses.name: Antu'sul
bosses.general: Basilisk master on the hill: calls basilisks, drops a Healing Ward and an Earthgrab totem.
bosses.tank: Grab the basilisks as they come.
bosses.dps: Kill the Healing Ward at once, area attacks on the basilisks, then him.

bosses.name: Theka the Martyr
bosses.general: Turns into a scarab near the end and becomes immune to physical damage; Fevered Plague.
bosses.tank: Keep threat with spells or hold on until the casters finish him.
bosses.dps: Casters finish him in scarab form; melee switch to wands or wait.

bosses.name: Witch Doctor Zum'rah
bosses.general: In the graveyard: raises zombies from the graves, Shadow Bolt Volley, and a Ward of Zum'rah.
bosses.tank: Pull him away from the graves, pick up the zombies.

bosses.name: Sergeant Bly
bosses.general: Free Bly's crew, then waves of trolls climb the pyramid stairs. After that the crew turns on us.
bosses.tank: Hold the top of the stairs; then pick up Bly's crew.
bosses.healer: Long fight: watch mana on the stairs.
bosses.dps: Area attacks on the stair waves; Murta the healer first in the crew fight.

bosses.name: Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz
bosses.general: Comes down after the pyramid waves with Nekrum: heals, Psychic Scream.

bosses.name: Nekrum Gutchewer
bosses.general: Big zombie with Sezz'ziz: hits hard.
bosses.tank: Hold him while the others kill the priest.

bosses.name: Hydromancer Velratha
bosses.general: Naga at the pool: Healing Wave and frost spells. Her death is needed for the mallet.

bosses.name: Gahz'rilla
bosses.general: Called with the Mallet of Zul'Farrak: Freeze Solid freezes a player, Gahz'rilla Slam knocks up, Icicles.
bosses.healer: Heal through the slams; keep the frozen alive.

bosses.name: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp
bosses.general: With Ruuzlu: Wide Slash cleaves and he enrages.
bosses.tank: Face Ukorz away from the group; pick up Ruuzlu too.
bosses.dps: Stay behind Ukorz; kill Ruuzlu first.
